question: Fill in the blank (4) with the appropriate word from the options below:
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**vital**" means absolutely necessary or essential; indispensable. (महत्वपूर्ण)
 
• Regular physical activity is crucial for maintaining good health and well-being.
 
• The other options: "**ardours**," "**colloquial**," and "**innocuous**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is ''**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *In addition to a nutritious diet, regular physical activity is vital__ for maintaining good health.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Ardours (प्रचंड परिश्रम)**: intense and passionate feelings or efforts.
 
• **Colloquial (बोलचाल की भाषा)**: used in ordinary or familiar conversation; not formal or literary.
 
• **Innocuous (हानी रहित)**: not harmful or offensive.
